{{nihongo|Takahiro Kawai|河合 隆裕|'''Kawai Takahiro'''|extra= born 1945, [[Tsushima, Aichi]]}} is a Japanese mathematician working on [[algebraic analysis]]. He is a professor emeritus at [[Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences|RIMS]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/en/list/KAWAI,%20Takahiro.html|title=Homepage of Takahiro Kawai at RIMS}}</ref> He was a student of [[Mikio Sato]] at the same time as [[Masaki Kashiwara]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Biographies/Sato.html|title=MacTutor Biography of Mikio Sato}}</ref> with whom he later shared the [[Asahi Prize]] in 1987.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.asahi.com/shimbun/award/asahi/english.html|title=Asahi Prize}}</ref>
